remove.deleteBody: Its photos, cut-out and details are deleted. Past looks, your calendar and trips keep their other pieces; a look styled around this piece is deleted with it.
remove.deleteBackup: This can't be undone. Copies in our encrypted backups expire within 30 days.
remove.eraseBody: The photo you took is erased for good. The cut-out garment stays in your past looks, calendar and wear history, and you can still put the piece back.
remove.eraseBackup: Copies in our encrypted backups expire within 30 days. An erased original can't be used to make a better cut-out later.
remove.archiveBody: It leaves your closet and won't appear in new looks. Past looks and your wear history keep it.
remove.archiveRestore: You can put it back from Removed pieces.

1.label: Fresh every day
1.hint: Every day gets fresh clothes. Expect the largest suitcase.

2.label: Worn twice
2.hint: One repeat per piece — a middle path for shorter trips.

3.label: Worn three times
3.hint: The sweet spot: a week out of nine pieces, nothing worn tired.

4.label: Worn four times
4.hint: A lighter bag. Bottoms and knitwear carry most of the repeats.

5.label: As often as it works
5.hint: The smallest possible case. Two shirts and one trouser do the week.
